scripts.dev:creator: npm run dev --workspace=apps/creator
scripts.build:creator: npm run build --workspace=apps/creator
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=packages/auth && npm run build --workspace=packages/ui && npm run build --workspace=packages/api-client && npm run build --workspace=packages/utils && npm run build --workspace=packages/build-config && npm run build --workspace=packages/testing
scripts.build:all: npm run build:packages && npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:website && npm run build:creator
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint --workspace=apps/dashboard && npm run lint --workspace=apps/website && npm run lint --workspace=apps/creator
scripts.test:all: npm run test --workspace=apps/dashboard -- --run && npm run test --workspace=apps/website -- --run
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace=apps/dashboard && npm run test:coverage --workspace=apps/website
scripts.test:e2e:creator: playwright test creator.spec.ts
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean --workspace=apps/dashboard && npm run clean --workspace=apps/website && npm run clean --workspace/packages/ui && npm run clean --workspace=packages/build-config
